title: List the cheapest products
prompt: Return the name and price of the five cheapest products that are not discontinued, cheapest first. The starter sorts in the wrong direction.
hints: Which direction puts the smallest price first?
Ascending is the default. DESC reverses it.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Sorts correctly but returns every product.

feedback: Check the first row and the number of rows. The cheapest product that is still sold comes first, and there are five rows.
